headline: Binance Details $6 Billion Crypto Heist Involving Fake Job Interviews
summary: Binance released an investigation showing that hackers utilized fake job interviews and malicious code to execute a $6 billion heist on its cryptocurrency platform.
why: Cybersecurity breaches and platform vulnerabilities pose operational and regulatory risks for major digital asset exchanges.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Platform security breach exposes significant funds to theft.
